title: A geometric approach to generalized covering radii of linear codes
summary: Covering problems in coding theory are closely related to finite geometry through the interpretation of the columns of parity-check matrices as point sets in finite vector spaces. Motivated by the recent notion of generalized covering radii of linear codes introduced by Elimelech, Firer and Schwartz, we develop a geometric framework for these parameters. We introduce $(ρ,t)$-saturating sets and show that they are precisely the finite-geometric counterparts of linear codes whose $t$-th generalized covering radius is at most $ρ$.
